publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
TEST ACCOUNT CREDENTIALS (use these for account linking):
Home Assistant URL: https://demo.ha-cloud.es:8443
Access Token (paste in "Token" field on the linking page): eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJiNDU0MmViOGJhMjk0MzYwYWZkZDQ3ODkwMjczMDE1NSIsImlhdCI6MTc5NTAzMTY0MiwiZXhwIjoyMTEwMzkxNjQyfQ.abh61DQCyBOcadfpsqpBCJg5guK0JJ_cuMpTetmGgDk

EASIER OPTION: on the linking page (ha-cloud.es/oauth/authorize.php) click the "Link demo" / "Vincular demo" button below the form — it links our hosted demo Home Assistant automatically, no credentials to type.

After linking, say "Alexa, discover devices" — 4 demo devices appear: Demo Lamp, Demo Switch, Demo Fan, Demo Blind. Test: "Alexa, turn on Demo Lamp", "Alexa, turn off Demo Fan".

Optional — browse the demo Home Assistant UI directly at https://demo.ha-cloud.es:8443 (user: amazon-cert / pass: AmazonCert-2026).

For real users: they enter their own Home Assistant HTTPS URL + long-lived access token generated by the HassDNS integration panel.

en-US.name: HassDNS Cloud for Home Assistant
en-US.summary: Control your Home Assistant devices with Alexa
en-US.description: HassDNS Cloud links your Home Assistant to Alexa: discover your entities and control lights, switches, thermostats, locks, covers, media players, scenes and more by voice. Sensors can also trigger Alexa routines.
examplePhrases: Alexa, turn on the living room light
Alexa, set the thermostat to 70 degrees

es-ES.name: HassDNS Cloud para Home Assistant
es-ES.summary: Controla tus dispositivos de Home Assistant con Alexa
es-ES.description: HassDNS Cloud conecta tu Home Assistant con Alexa: descubre tus entidades y controla luces, enchufes, termostatos, cerraduras, persianas, media players y escenas con la voz. Los sensores tambien pueden disparar rutinas de Alexa.
examplePhrases: Alexa, enciende la luz del salon
Alexa, pon el termostato a 21 grados
